description: This bar chart illustrates the average values for several models, labeled as PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The horizontal axis displays the model names in the order PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, Eeve-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG, while the vertical axis represents the value, labeled as “AVG”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1.00, with tick marks at intervals of 0.10. Each model is represented by a pair of bars, one light blue and one dark blue. The shortest bar, representing PT-EVAL, has a light blue height of approximately 0.42 and a dark blue height of approximately 0.46. The tallest bars, representing SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base), have a light blue height of approximately 0.59 and a dark blue height of approximately 0.61. The bars are grouped, with the light blue bars representing the “SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)” model and the dark blue bars representing the “whale (our)” model, as indicated by the legend. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
